title: Display station unique IDs on Map Monitor using “View Station Ids” icon
summary: Use the Map Monitor Quick Select panel to display station unique IDs on the map. Stations are special locations with unique IDs (distinct from cells), which helps identify and debug station-related issues.
when_to_use: When you need to visually identify station locations on the Map Monitor map and confirm station unique IDs are being shown (for station-related debugging/identification).
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Map Monitor Quick Select steps to enable station ID display and verify station objects show unique IDs on the map.
access_or_tools_needed: Quick Select panel icon “View Station Ids”

visual_references.description: Map Monitor Quick Select panel showing the “View Station Ids” icon and related icons (e.g., View all AGV active paths, View Charger Ids, Robot Selection, Cell Selection).

steps.title: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons
steps.purpose: Access the Quick Select panel where the “View Station Ids” icon is located.
steps.instruction: Open the Map Monitor screen that includes the Quick Select panel with the icons (including “View Station Ids”).
steps.expected_result: The Quick Select panel with the “View Station Ids” icon is visible on the Map Monitor screen.
steps.healthy_condition: You can see the Quick Select icons area that includes “View Station Ids”.
steps.failure_condition: The Quick Select panel (and/or the “View Station Ids” icon) is not visible.

actions.label: Open Map Monitor
actions.exact_action: Open the Map Monitor screen that contains the Quick Select icons.

steps.title: Click the “View Station Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel
steps.purpose: Enable station unique ID labels on the map.
steps.instruction: In the Quick Select panel, click the “View Station Ids” icon.
steps.expected_result: Station unique IDs are enabled for display on the map (station objects will show unique IDs).
steps.healthy_condition: After clicking, station objects on the map display unique station IDs.
steps.failure_condition: After clicking, station objects do not show unique station IDs.

actions.label: Enable station ID display
actions.exact_action: Click the “View Station Ids” icon in the Quick Select panel.

steps.title: Verify station locations show unique station IDs on the map
steps.purpose: Confirm the map is displaying station unique IDs as intended.
steps.instruction: On the map, look for station objects showing unique station IDs.
steps.expected_result: Station objects display unique station IDs on the map.
steps.healthy_condition: Station objects (special locations) show unique IDs; cells are a different object type and are not treated as stations for ID display.
steps.failure_condition: Station objects do not display unique station IDs.

actions.label: Inspect map labels
actions.exact_action: On the map, verify that station locations are shown with unique station IDs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If station IDs are not visible, stop and escalate (no remediation steps are provided in the source).

steps.title: Interpret station vs cell distinction when reading the map
steps.purpose: Avoid misidentifying cells as stations when reading the displayed IDs.
steps.instruction: When interpreting the map, use the source-provided distinction: stations are special locations with unique IDs, while cells are a different object type (described as light blue/gray in the source).
steps.expected_result: You can correctly distinguish station objects (unique station IDs) from cells (different object type/color).
steps.healthy_condition: Station objects correspond to the “station” category described in the source (special locations) and show unique IDs; cells correspond to the “cell” category described in the source (light blue/gray).
steps.failure_condition: You cannot reliably distinguish station objects from cells, or you interpret cell objects as stations.

actions.label: Use station vs cell distinction
actions.exact_action: Use the source-provided distinction when interpreting the map: stations are special locations with unique IDs, while cells are different object types (light blue/gray).

success_criteria: Station objects display unique station IDs on the Map Monitor map after selecting “View Station Ids”.
Station vs cell distinction is correctly applied when reading the map (stations are special locations with unique IDs; cells are a different object type).
healthy_conditions: Quick Select panel is accessible and “View Station Ids” can be clicked.
Station objects show unique station IDs on the map.
failure_conditions: Station IDs are not visible after clicking “View Station Ids”.
Station vs cell distinction cannot be applied (cells mistaken for stations).
escalation_guidance: If station IDs are not visible, stop and escalate because the source provides no remediation steps.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Quick Select panel icon labeled “View Station Ids” (and related icons for context).

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Quick Select panel icon labeled “View Station Ids” (and related icons for context).

missing_details: The source does not provide troubleshooting/remediation steps for cases where station IDs do not appear; it only instructs to stop and escalate.
